reproduce.title: Avoid redundant equivalent app shortcut results
prerequisites: Windows with Command Palette Installed Apps enabled
setup: Create Start-menu and Desktop shortcuts to the same harmless executable with identical arguments.
steps: Search for the executable and observe result sources.
Change one shortcut's arguments and search again.
Compare behavior when the Desktop and Start-menu sources are toggled.
reproduce.expected_result: Equivalent shortcuts can be consolidated without hiding shortcuts with different launch behavior.
